The use of HPL in exterior wall coverings is subject to the following limitations:
   1.   HPL is prohibited in exterior wall coverings in Type IV construction utilizing cross-laminated timer (CLT) or structural composite lumber (SCL) complying with Section 602.4.
   2.   HPL is prohibited in exterior wall coverings at exterior balconies and shall comply with Section 1406.3.

The use of HPL in exterior wall coverings is subject to the following limitations:

 1. HPL is prohibited in exterior wall coverings in Type IV construction utilizing cross-laminated timer (CLT) or structural composite lumber (SCL) complying with Section 602.4.

 2. HPL is prohibited in exterior wall coverings at exterior balconies and shall comply with Section 1406.3.
